entries.name: Dodge Dash
entries.how_to: Tap Evade; hold it to guard.

entries.name: Breath Control
entries.desc: Stay underwater 30 s; swim deep water for 30 s; enter flooded rooms.
entries.how_to: Deep water no longer pulls you under at once: you swim for 30 s.

entries.name: Plunge
entries.desc: In the air, pull down and attack: drop at 900 and strike all within 60 for 120% damage and a 0.5 s stun. Cooldown 4 s.
entries.how_to: In the air: joystick down + Attack.

entries.name: Falling Leaf Glide
entries.desc: Hold Jump while falling: drift down at 120 a second and 10% faster across. Costs 2 QI a second.

entries.name: Swallow Dart
entries.desc: Evade in the air: dart 140 and hold your height for a breath. Once before you land; shares the dodge's cooldown.

entries.name: Cloud Ladder Step
entries.desc: Jump again in the air: a second jump of +80 from where you use it, once before you land.
entries.how_to: In the air: press Jump again.

entries.name: Water Skimming
entries.desc: Sprint across deep water as if it were stone. Stop for half a second and you sink.
entries.how_to: Sprint onto deep water and keep running.

entries.name: Wall-Step
entries.desc: Jump while pushing into a wall: kick up 88 and 90 away. Three kicks before you land.
entries.how_to: In the air, push into a wall and press Jump.

entries.name: Concealment
entries.desc: Enemies' aggro range -50% while not attacking.

entries.name: Lotus Heart Breathing
entries.desc: Heal 2% HP per second for 5 s.
